snippet.title: The Core Gameplay of Myths are 100% True ( Trailer )
snippet.description:
A game by Me and @ClayGod AND music by @mudeth 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3047510/Myths_are_100_True/

A Trailer to show the essence of Myths are 100% True's gameplay.



There was also a small quality of life update, so we're releasing this to let everyone know the game exists..... but it won't be the last!
Soon we'll be working on a new major update, but soon I will start working on and posting Sorta Devs that covers the Chapters of this game beyond the Demo! I guess I have a lot to say about this game, but I also wanna do non-sorta-devs between sorta devs, so this is actually gonna be a busy year for this channel!

Also, here's a link to join the Discord Server where people can discuss this game in one of the channels:
https://discord.gg/U8HaTSgCuP
